segments.sn24.45:1.2: “Kismiṃ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṃ upādāya, kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.45:1.3: ‘na vātā vāyanti, na najjo sandanti, na gabbhiniyo vijāyanti, na candimasūriyā udenti vā apenti vā esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā’”ti?
segments.sn24.45:2.1: “Rūpe kho, bhikkhave, sati, rūpaṃ upādāya, rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati – na vātā vāyanti … pe … vedanāya sati … saññāya sati … saṅkhāresu sati … viññāṇe sati, viññāṇaṃ upādāya, viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.45:3.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.45:3.3: “Aniccaṃ, bhante”… pe … vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.45:3.8: Tasmiṃ sati, tadupādāya, evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.45:3.9: ‘na vātā vāyanti, na najjo sandanti, na gabbhiniyo vijāyanti, na candimasūriyā udenti vā apenti vā esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā’”ti.
segments.sn24.45:3.10: “Vedanā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.45:3.14: “Aniccaṃ, bhante”… pe … vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.45:3.19: Tasmiṃ sati, tadupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.45:3.21: Paṭhamaṃ. 251-274.(Dutiyavagge viya catuvīsati suttāni pūretabbāni.) Pañcavīsatimaṃ.
